title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: The first words after a mistake
hook: A kid misses an easy one. Everyone is watching you.
intro: The ball rolls right past your player.
They look straight at the sideline.
statement: Your next words decide how they play the next minute.
q1: Do you say something quick and encouraging —
q2: or say nothing and let them reset?
q3: What does that player need from you right now?
t1: Both can work. But players recover faster
cta: Coaches — what do you say after a mistake?
ctaLines: Next play. Shake it off. A thumbs up.
ctaPrompt: Share your sideline habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A kid misses an easy one. Everyone is watching you.
The ball rolls right past your player. They look straight at the sideline.
Your next words decide how they play the next minute.
A quick word or quiet space. There is no single right way.
What do you say after a mistake? Share your habit in the comments.
